import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from run_p_scoped import cut, WORK, BRANCH
scoped = json.loads((root / 'P_scoped_launch.json').read_text())
while not cut.terminal(scoped):
    time.sleep(10)
assert cut.read(WORK / 'acceptance_summary.json')['state'] == 'PASSED'
assert cut.read(BRANCH / 'safeguards/acceptance_summary.json')['passed']
os.execv(cut.PYTHON, [cut.PYTHON, '-B', '-u', str(root / 'run_g5.py'), 'P'])
